tools.name: check_perp_order
tools.description: Checks a Hyperliquid perp order BEFORE your agent sends it: would the exchange reject it, and what does it cost and risk? Give coin, side and size (coins, as you would send it) or notional (USD); optional limit price (omit = market order), leverage, margin cross/isolated, reduceOnly. Returns verdict

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_perp_order · Public sink: check_perp_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_perp_order · Public sink: check_perp_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
